qz-level9-u6.title: U6
qz-level9-u6.source_description: 使用者提供的 Lesson 6 單字與片語頁；依編號收錄，裁切例句另標示 AI 補寫。

vocab.sentence: We have the freedom to choose our own clothes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們有選擇自己衣服的自由。

vocab.sentence: There is a stone statue in front of the museum.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 博物館前面有一座石雕像。

vocab.sentence: Jasmine chewed gum to remove the smell of garlic.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Jasmine 嚼口香糖來去除大蒜味。

vocab.sentence: We had a party in celebration of winning the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們開派對慶祝贏得比賽。

vocab.sentence: The country gained independence more than fifty years ago.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個國家在五十多年前獲得獨立。

vocab.sentence: The monument was built to remember a great leader.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座紀念碑是為了紀念一位偉大的領袖而建造的。

vocab.sentence: The white flowers symbolize peace in this story.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在這個故事中，這些白花象徵和平。

vocab.sentence: Jack firmly closed the lid of the jar so that it wouldn't open accidentally.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Jack 牢牢蓋上罐子的蓋子，以免它意外打開。

vocab.sentence: Amy was chosen to represent her class in the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Amy 被選出來代表她的班級參加比賽。

vocab.sentence: We visited an ancient city during our trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在旅行中參觀了一座古城。

vocab.sentence: People in slavery were forced to work without pay.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 處於奴隸身分的人被迫無償工作。

vocab.sentence: It is unfair to blame her for your mistake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 因為你自己的錯誤而責怪她是不公平的。

vocab.sentence: The workers complained about the unfair treatment they received.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 工人們抱怨自己受到的不公平待遇。

vocab.sentence: The tourist asked me how to get to the museum.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位遊客問我如何前往博物館。

vocab.chinese: 有吸引力的事物或地點
vocab.sentence: The old castle is a popular tourist attraction.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座古堡是一個熱門的觀光景點。

vocab.sentence: The tall tower has become a famous city landmark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座高塔已成為著名的城市地標。

vocab.sentence: People around the globe watched the game on TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 世界各地的人們在電視上觀看這場比賽。

phrases.sentence: Even though it was raining, we still went out.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 儘管當時正在下雨，我們還是出門了。

phrases.sentence: Close to fifty people visited the museum today.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 今天有將近五十人參觀博物館。

phrases.sentence: The work became easier over time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 隨著時間過去，這份工作變得更容易了。

phrases.sentence: We paid a visit to the old museum yesterday.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天參觀了那座老博物館。

phrases.sentence: As always, Ben arrived at school early.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 如往常一樣，Ben 很早就到學校了。
